name: playwright-codelens-runner
description: Playwright CodeLens actions with official Run/Debug integration and scoped Inspector/UI commands

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Running Playwright tests requires executing arbitrary code from the workspace.

playwrightCodeLensRunner.configFiles.markdownDescription: Playwright config files to use, relative to a workspace folder or absolute. Supports `${workspaceFolder}`, `${packageRoot}` and `${configDir}` variables. When empty, conventional `playwright*.config.*` files are discovered automatically in every workspace folder.

playwrightCodeLensRunner.cli.executable.markdownDescription: Explicit Playwright CLI executable (e.g. `npx`, `pnpm`, `yarn`, or a path to a locally installed CLI). When empty, the local package manager or local Playwright installation is detected automatically.

playwrightCodeLensRunner.cli.arguments.markdownDescription: Arguments inserted before the Playwright sub-command when using a custom `playwrightCodeLensRunner.cli.executable` (e.g. `["playwright"]` for `npx`). Never interpolated into a shell string.

playwrightCodeLensRunner.workingDirector.markdownDescription: Working directory used to run the Playwright CLI. Supports `${workspaceFolder}`, `${packageRoot}` and `${configDir}`. Defaults to the directory containing the Playwright config file.

playwrightCodeLensRunner.runOptions.markdownDescription: Extra CLI options appended to companion Inspector and Playwright UI runs. Native Run/Debug options are owned by the Microsoft Playwright extension (see https://playwright.dev/docs/test-cli).

enumDescriptions: Use the Playwright config and the companion's configured CLI projects.
Use the config project named chromium, or Playwright's Chromium browser when no projects are defined.
Use the config project named firefox, or Playwright's Firefox browser when no projects are defined.
Use the config project named webkit, or Playwright's WebKit browser when no projects are defined.
playwrightCodeLensRunner.inspector.brows.markdownDescription: Browser used only by **Inspect Test/Suite**. `config` preserves Playwright config behavior and **Configure CLI Projects**. A forced browser selects the same-named config project; Playwright does not permit `--browser` when a config defines projects.

playwrightCodeLensRunner.environment.markdownDescription: Environment variables added to companion CLI discovery, Inspector, UI, report, trace, and codegen processes. Values support variable substitution.

playwrightCodeLensRunner.codeLens.enable.markdownDescription: Show Run, Debug, Inspect, and Playwright UI actions above test files, `test.describe` blocks, and tests.

playwrightCodeLensRunner.codeLens.patter.markdownDescription: Glob pattern selecting documents that receive Playwright CodeLens actions.

enumDescriptions: Show the complete file, suite, and test action sets.
Show Run, Debug, and More… for every declaration.
Use the fileActions, suiteActions, and testActions settings below.
playwrightCodeLensRunner.codeLens.layout.markdownDescription: CodeLens layout. `custom` lets you choose separate actions for files, suites, and tests.

playwrightCodeLensRunner.codeLens.fileAc.markdownDescription: Actions shown for a file when `codeLens.layout` is `custom`. `config` shows the companion CLI config selector; file Inspect is intentionally unavailable.

playwrightCodeLensRunner.codeLens.suiteA.markdownDescription: Actions shown for a suite when `codeLens.layout` is `custom`.

playwrightCodeLensRunner.codeLens.testAc.markdownDescription: Actions shown for a test when `codeLens.layout` is `custom`. `cases` appears only for collapsed generated/data-driven cases.
